subject: Re: Encord - Interest
text:
Hi Sara,

Encord was recommended as a platform capable of performing the tasks I
need. There are five members of my group, but I would only need one or two
licenses. The product will be an internal only document meant for my
organization alone.

In case you did not see this from my original request. I am seeking to
synthesize a high-volume archive of Google Gemini exports (hundreds of
Google Docs) into a structured, unified knowledge base. The goal is to
consolidate related concepts, eliminate redundancies, and organize the
material into discrete, compartmentalized sections. This final output must
serve as a functional 'living document'; modular enough for manual
refinement, yet structured specifically to serve as a high-context
foundation for future AI-assisted analysis and editing.

What packages do you have available that could handle this task?  I am also
interested in exploring other capabilities you offer with future
operations.

Best regards,
Tony Parker
